question: Identify the driver who achieved the single fastest lap time (i.e., the minimum non-null fastestLapTime) across all Formula 1 races held at circuits in Spain. Return the driver’s full name, nationality, the name of the race where this record was set, and the geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) of the circuit. Additionally, include the total number of wins this driver has accumulated in their career based on driverStandings records.

WITH fastest_lap AS (
    SELECT
        r.XCL_075 AS driverId,
        r.XCL_074 AS raceId,
        r.XCL_088 AS fastestLapTime
    FROM results r
    INNER JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
    INNER JOIN circuits c ON ra.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_005 = 'Spain'
      AND r.XCL_088 IS NOT NULL
),
min_lap AS (
    SELECT MIN(fastestLapTime) AS min_time
    FROM fastest_lap
),
target_driver AS (
    SELECT fl.driverId, fl.raceId
    FROM fastest_lap fl
    INNER JOIN min_lap ml ON fl.fastestLapTime = ml.min_time
)
SELECT
    d.XCL_038 AS forename,
    d.XCL_039 AS surname,
    d.XCL_041 AS nationality,
    ra.XCL_069 AS race_name,
    c.XCL_006 AS latitude,
    c.XCL_007 AS longitude,
    (SELECT SUM(ds.XCL_033) FROM driverStandings ds WHERE ds.XCL_029 = d.XCL_034) AS total_wins
FROM target_driver td
INNER JOIN drivers d ON td.driverId = d.XCL_034
INNER JOIN races ra ON td.raceId = ra.XCL_065
INNER JOIN circuits c ON ra.XCL_068 = c.XCL_001
